title: What is Long? What is Round?

learn.hook: A snake and a worm went for a walk. Who is longer?
points: Long things stretch a big way from end to end.
Short things stretch only a little way.
To compare, put both ends at the same start line.
Longest means more long than all others. Shortest means less long than all.

example.q: Riya has a pencil and a crayon. Both start at the same line. The pencil ends farther. Which is longer?
steps: Line up one end of both.

learn.reallife: A train is long. A toffee is short. A plait can be long or short.

games.title: Shortest to longest
games.prompt: Put them from shortest to longest

games.title: True or false?
items: A train is longer than a car.
A train has many coaches. It is very long.
A spoon is longer than a bed.
A bed is much longer than a spoon.
To compare length, start both things at the same line.
Then the one that ends farther is longer.
An eraser is longer than a cricket bat.
A cricket bat is much longer.
A giraffe's neck is longer than a cat's tail.
A giraffe has a very long neck.

quiz.explain: A cricket bat is much longer than a tiny matchstick.
A paper clip is the shortest of the three.
quiz.mistake: Picks the longest instead of the shortest

quiz.q: Meena's ribbon is long. Aisha's ribbon is short. Whose ribbon is longer?
quiz.explain: Long is more than short. So Meena's ribbon is longer.

quiz.q: Two sticks start at the same line. Stick A ends first. Which is shorter?
quiz.explain: The stick that ends first does not go as far. So Stick A is shorter.

quiz.q: Which animal has a long trunk?
quiz.explain: Only the elephant has a trunk. It is long!
quiz.mistake: Does not know which animal has a trunk

quiz.q: Kabir lays a pen next to a ruler. The ruler is longer. Which is shorter?
quiz.explain: If the ruler is longer, the pen must be shorter.
quiz.mistake: Gets confused between longer and shorter

teach.ask: Gappu: My worm and my pencil look the same. How do I know which is longer?
teach.praise: Clever! Line them up and see which goes farther!
teach.nudge: Should I put them at the same start? Which word tells me long or short?

learn.hook: A ball and a plate are at a party. Which can bounce away?
points: Round things have curved sides, like a ball.
Flat things have flat faces, like a book.
A ball is round all over. It has no flat face.
Some things have both, like a tin can. Its sides are curved. Its top is flat.

example.q: Is a dice round or flat?
steps: All its faces are flat squares.

learn.reallife: A laddoo and a ball are round. A book and a carrom board are flat.

quiz.q: Which one is round all over?
quiz.explain: A ball is curved everywhere. Books and bricks have flat faces.
A dice has 6 flat faces. Oranges and marbles are round.

quiz.q: A square gift box is shaped like a ___.
quiz.explain: A box with square faces is like a cube.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every solid is a sphere

quiz.q: A sheet of paper is flat. Which is also flat?
quiz.explain: A notebook cover is flat like the paper. A laddoo and a ball are round.

quiz.q: A tin of ghee has curved sides. What shape is it like?
quiz.explain: A tin has a curved side and two flat round ends. That is a cylinder.
quiz.mistake: Thinks all curved things are spheres

quiz.q: Joseph's birthday cap is pointy at the top. It is like a ___.
quiz.explain: A birthday cap has a round bottom and a point on top. That is a cone.

teach.ask: Gappu: I found a ball and a book. Are they the same shape?
teach.praise: Yes! A ball is round. A book is flat!
teach.nudge: Which one is round? Which one is flat?

learn.hook: Push a ball and push a book. What happens?
points: Round things can roll, like a ball or a bangle.
Things with flat faces slide when we push them.
A cylinder can roll on its side. It slides on its flat end.
A cube cannot roll. It can only slide.

example.q: Can a tin of biscuits roll and slide?
steps: Lay the tin on its curved side. Push. It rolls.
Stand it on its flat end. Push. It slides.
example.answer: Yes, it can roll and slide.

learn.reallife: Wheels roll on the road. A cupboard slides when we push it.

games.title: True or false?
items: A ball is round all over. It rolls easily.
A book can roll down a slope.
A book has flat faces. It slides.
A tin can roll on its curved side.
The curved side lets it roll.
A dice rolls smoothly like a ball.
A dice has flat faces. It tumbles but does not roll smoothly.
A cylinder can slide on its flat end.
Its flat end sits flat, so it can slide.

quiz.explain: A marble is round. Round things roll.

quiz.q: Which one will slide, not roll?
quiz.explain: A box has flat faces. It slides.

quiz.q: Why can a bicycle wheel roll?
quiz.explain: Round things roll. A wheel is round.

quiz.q: Arjun pushes a cube. What does it do?
quiz.explain: A cube has flat faces. It slides.

quiz.q: Which can roll on one side and slide on another?
quiz.explain: A tin rolls on its curved side. It slides on its flat end.
quiz.mistake: Picks something that does only one

quiz.q: Aisha wants a toy that rolls down a slide. Which should she pick?
quiz.explain: A ball is round, so it rolls down.

teach.ask: Gappu: Why does my ball roll away but my book stays?
teach.praise: Now I know! Round things roll. Flat things slide!
teach.nudge: What shape is the ball? What does a flat thing do?
